question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin gain hybrid BM25-plus-vector retrieval, or should OpenClaw explicitly leave that optional capability to the maintained community plugin?
rationale: Both directions work with current plugin and LanceDB contracts; VISION.md favors externally maintained optional plugins, but repeated item-specific reviews have kept official parity open, so maintainer intent is needed to settle ownership and defaults.

options.title: Implement official parity
options.body: Keep this issue open for a focused official-plugin change with explicit indexing, scoring, fallback, configuration, tests, documentation, and real retrieval proof.

options.title: Adopt community handoff
options.body: Close this issue to ClawHub and direct hybrid-search users to CortexReach/memory-lancedb-pro without expanding the official plugin.

recommendation.title: Implement official parity
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a focused official-plugin change with explicit indexing, scoring, fallback, configuration, tests, documentation, and real retrieval proof.
